messages.name: bang
messages.description: Reports the current open outlet (0 if closed) out the left outlet.

messages.name: int
messages.description: The number specifies an open outlet through which to pass all messages received in the right inlet. A number in the left inlet does not trigger any output.

messages.name: next
messages.description: Sending themessage to the left inlet will close the current outlet and open the next one, wrapping accross all outlets. If currently closed (set to 0) or set to the rightmost outlet, outlet 1 will be opened.

inlets.digest: 0 Closes gate, Non-zero Opens Gate Outlet
